Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans receiving Department of Veterans Affairs medical services, automobile adaptation benefits, or specific institutionalized pension payments.
dimensions.evidence: clarify that the Department of Veterans Affairs definition of 'medical services' includes medically necessary automobile adaptations

dimensions.assessment: Clarifies and expands the specific types of automobile adaptations covered (such as ramp systems, lowered floors, and adapted seating) and maintains existing pension limits for institutionalized veterans.
dimensions.evidence: The provision of any medically necessary automobile adaptations for driver or passenger use, including... ramp and kneeling systems; lowered floors; adapted seating.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes VA funding for expanded automobile adaptations and extends pension payment limitations through fiscal year 2032.
dimensions.evidence: the Department of Veterans Affairs may provide funding for the following medically necessary automobile adaptations

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38, United States Code, by updating the statutory definition of medical services for veterans and extending a pension limitation sunset date.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1701(6)(I) of title 38, United States Code, is amended to read as follows

dimensions.assessment: Provides permanent expansion of the medical services definition alongside a pension limitation extension through September 30, 2032.

missing_information: Total federal cost estimates and the exact number of veterans utilizing these specific vehicle adaptations are not stated.
importance_detail.rationale: Expands the definition of medical services for veterans to include specific medically necessary automobile adaptations and extends the limitation on pension amounts for certain hospitalized veterans through September 30, 2032.
